title: Read the active provider catalog once per endpoint registration pass
goal: Reduce measured startup time while preserving configured URLs, aliases, key precedence, privacy checks, and visibility of extension changes on subsequent passes.

receipt.scope: Isolated Windows invocation of the actual provider registration function. Each child had a private home, no real provider credentials, and an empty provider result.
receipt.verified_behavior: Provider aliases, per-provider URL isolation, saved-file lookup, current process precedence and updates between passes.
